required: one otherwise plain unpanelled leaf and complete slim squared casing
exactly one deep near-black full-height recessed channel at far left
one slim light-gray inner vertical boundary beside that channel
exactly one extremely thin horizontal hairline across the leaf on the handle axis
exactly one round handle rosette, one straight horizontal lever and one separate round key escutcheon
no extra panel, seam, groove, line, channel, hardware, text, badge, brand or logo
signature.nativeDetailInspection: All nine accepted files preserve the exact one-horizontal-line design, full-height left channel, hardware count and placement, full casing and NO_LOGO policy.
